input.quote: This Agreement will automatically renew for additional 1-year terms unless earlier terminated pursuant to this Agreement's express provisions
input.rationale: Paragraph 4(a) auto-renews the Agreement for successive 1-year terms but contains no non-renewal notice mechanic. Our only exit is the for-any-reason right, which requires ninety (90) days' notice and is available only "following the Initial Term", so we cannot avoid the first renewal at all and thereafter face a 90-day exit window. That fails the fallback element of a non-renewal notice window of no more than 60 days (the renewal term itself is 12 months, so not walk-away multi-year). We therefore add a Customer-only 60-day non-renewal notice right at the fallback level, leaving the mutual termination rights untouched. Renewal is on existing terms and the Agreement contains no renewal price-increase mechanic (fees are a revenue share under an Exhibit), so the conditional 5% uplift cap is not triggered and we have not volunteered new pricing language.

proposal.summary: Add a 60-day Customer non-renewal notice right to the auto-renewal mechanic
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement auto-renews for successive 1-year terms with no non-renewal mechanic, so our only exit is the 90 days' notice right that is available only after the Initial Term. We have added a Customer right to decline renewal on 60 days' written notice, which is our fallback position (no non-renewal window longer than 60 days); renewal pricing is unchanged, so no uplift cap is needed.

ops.oldText: The initial term of this Agreement shall be one (1) year from the Effective Date (the "Initial Term"). This Agreement will automatically renew for additional 1-year terms unless earlier terminated pursuant to this Agreement's express provisions (together with the Initial Term, such additional periods the "Term").
ops.newText: The initial term of this Agreement shall be one (1) year from the Effective Date (the "Initial Term"). This Agreement will automatically renew for additional 1-year terms unless Customer gives written notice of non-renewal at least sixty (60) days prior to the end of the then-current term, or earlier terminated pursuant to this Agreement's express provisions (together with the Initial Term, such additional periods the "Term").

mappings.element: If renewal is automatic, Customer's non-renewal notice window is no more than 60 days.
If renewal permits price increases, each increase is capped at 5 percent.
